message.content:
The bug is at lines 18–19: ApplicationData records are decrypted and dispatched without checking that `c->state == Established`. Since the server requires TLS 1.3 client authentication, an attacker can send application data before completing the Certificate/CertificateVerify/Finished exchange, bypassing client authentication entirely.

Answer: 18,19
